content:
Aisha Patel: FYI Skybound's weekly active calls dropped 48% this week. Saw warning flag on renewal likelihood. Trying a quick re-engage before they schedule a downgrade review.
Jorge Morales: ugh. Account shipped a product integration in Jan, they hit the quota spike but then nothing. Do we have a recent health check?
Aisha Patel: last health check 2026-02-10 — adoption looked ok then. Usage telemetry shows ingestion pipelines failing for two customers this month. I pinged infra but need a CSM play we can run this week.
Mallory Chen: propose a 2-week "mini-surge": 1) 60-min targeted enablement for their ops team, 2) one-time 20% credit for January overage, 3) a clear downgrade path doc so they don't feel trapped.
Evan Li: I can run the enablement. Short agenda: (a) quick triage of ingestion failures, (b) best practices for batching + retry, (c) where to pin model versions for stability. I can do Wed or Thu.
Jorge Morales: Ben, any support tickets pinned to Skybound this month?
Ben (support-bot): Open tickets: #9871 (ingest timeout), #9902 (auth token rotate), #9940 (embedding anomalies). Last update on #9871 was 2026-03-03 by eng-runtime.
Aisha Patel: thanks. Mallory, can you draft the downgrade path doc? Need to outline two safe low-touch plans: "lite" and "core" with diff in features and SLA. Also include rollback/fallback options to avoid data loss.
Mallory Chen: on it. I'll reuse the downgrade matrix but will keep language focused on retention incentives (credits + targeted enablement). ETA EOD tomorrow.
Jorge Morales: I'm willing to offer a one-month pilot at discounted price if the enablement is scheduled within 7 days. That might stop the churn momentum.
Evan Li: Wed 10am PT works for me. Aisha — can you confirm with the customer? I want to include a short diagnostics checklist to run before the call: `curl` to health endpoint, sample payload, and last ingestion logs.
Aisha Patel: pinged Skybound CSM thread — they asked for options. Confirmed Wed 10am PT. I also asked them to attach 2 sample logs before the call.
Ben (support-bot): Reminder set: enablement session Wed 2026-03-10 17:00 UTC. Ticket #9871 assigned to eng-runtime for deep-dive.
Mallory Chen: Draft of downgrade doc: `Lite` - remove non-essential reranking, limit concurrent streams to 2, maintain embeddings updates weekly. `Core` - disable realtime rerank, reduce retention window to 7 days, maintain analytics hooks. Each plan includes escape hatch: immediate roll-forward to previous snapshot and a 24h on-call eng rotation.
Jorge Morales: love the escape hatch. Add a sentence about billing credit being applied only if we complete enablement and the pilot shows >10% improvement in usage. Keeps it measurable.
Aisha Patel: agreed. Next steps: Mallory finalizes doc by EOD tomorrow; Evan prepares diagnostics snippet; Jorge preps the pilot agreement; I'll run the customer invite and confirm logs. I'll post a short recap in this thread after the call.
Evan Li: I'll prep a 15-min pre-call diagnostic runbook and drop it here.
Mallory Chen: uploaded doc to Drive and shared with the account thread. Link: https://redwood.app/drive/skybound-rehab-plan (shared view).
Aisha Patel: thanks team. Quick note: please mark any co-browsing or screen-share needs in the invite so I can get SSO access for their ops lead.
Jorge Morales: noted. :thumbsup:
Ben (support-bot): Follow-up reminder scheduled for 2026-03-17 17:00 UTC to check renewal posture.
Aisha Patel: Closing loop — call happened, enabled fixes in 2 areas, customer accepted 1-month pilot discount. I'll open a short post-call play note and move to 'at-risk -> engaged' in CRM. Will update thread with final renewal decision. :party:
